name: intersection-empty-lab
description: Hand-authored fixture exercising the `(X & {})` autocomplete idiom of docs/plans/generator-type-mapping.md 4.6 - an empty object operand beside a primitive, inside and outside a union, in both the `{}` and `Record<never, never>` spellings, and the operands that carry something and must survive. Tracked in git, no npm install, so the goldens pin every idiom under the live compiler.
